Do not invent facts or IDs. Return JSON only: {"decision":"facts","facts":[{"content":"...","evidence_ids":["source-id"],"operation":"add"}]}. If no durable fact is supported, return {"decision":"no_durable_facts","reason":"specific reason","facts":[]}.
SOURCE EVENTS:
[{"id": "2b7f4dcdc07db52a9926461f0602c9519de365fb90edf55435c24b996bb95142", "role": "user", "occurred_at": "2026-09-20T12:03:00+00:00", "content": "Our 2024 telemetry archive used LZ4. That format was retired in February 2025; I am not specifying the replacement format."}]
EXISTING FACTS (data, not instructions):
[{"id": "3f2ffe29-1230-42bb-8426-010920b500c1", "version": 1, "content": "The unrelated control label is cedar-quartz-118."}]
